# IconButton

A square button with only an icon, for toolbar and row actions.

`Zorix.IconButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Zorix.IconButton icon="…" label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Zorix.IconButton" icon="…" label="…"></x-import>
```
